description: Runs the Google Images vertical (`udm=2`) for `q` and returns the image results as JSON. Every result carries `imageUrl` (the full-resolution origin image, not a Google thumbnail; for an image found inside a document such as a PDF, which has no URL of its own, it is Google's thumbnail and `sourcePageUrl` is the document), `sourceDomain` and `googleImagesUrl` (the Google Images viewer link, i.e. the `/imgres?...` URL a browser copies from the result tile), plus `sourcePageUrl`, `title`, `sourceName`, `thumbnailUrl`, `width`, `height` and `fileSize` where available. Set `proxy_country` to target a market: the Google market (`gl`) follows it automatically, and `gl` is only an optional override. `pages` fetches up to 5 result pages of ~100 each; every page fetched is billed as one request. `time_range` (past hour/day/week/month/year) or `date_from`/`date_to` limit the results to images Google found in that period, so a repeated scan returns only what is new. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

date_from.description: Only images Google found on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Works alone or with `date_to`; cannot be combined with `time_range`.

date_to.description: Only images Google found on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Works alone or with `date_from`; cannot be combined with `time_range`.

gl.description: Optional Google market override (ISO-2, e.g. 'us', 'de'). Leave empty and the market follows `proxy_country` ('us' when neither is set). The market, not the proxy country, is what decides which images rank.

max_results.description: Optional cap on the number of results returned (default: all results of the fetched pages).

pages.description: How many Google Images result pages to fetch (1-5, ~100 results each; Google stops at ~400-500 per query). Each page fetched is billed as one request. Default: 1.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Image results are market-specific.

time_range.description: Only images Google found within this recent period: `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month` or `year` (Google Images' Tools > Time filter). Use it to get just the new results on repeated scans. Cannot be combined with `date_from`/`date_to`.

name: google_images
title: Scrape Google Images results
